reasons.text: The duplicate check found another claim sharing the same serial number (13a0197e-c63b-5e50-891e-87d220fb596c). Under the claim policy, any shared serial number must go to a person for review together with the matching claim.

The other eligibility checks all pass, so this claim is not denied on the merits: the label photo is legible and shows model DR2A, which is recalled (T1, T2); serial J0E5490210 is in the recalled range (T3); date code 2017 is in the recalled model year range (T4); the Yamaha dealer purchase on 2019-02-01 is inside the sale window with no receipt required (T5); no destruction photo is required because the remedy is repair (T6).
